title: FCH gated micelles SIBWD replicates on seed 3; the shell ring is beyond diffusion (Laplacian twins peak in the core at every D), the cargo containment is not
summary: Fresh seed 3: ~34 micelles from white noise by t=16, 19 persistent splits (generation 2); shell q rim/core 10.8 with 244/247 cells membrane-like; cargo 30x at t=400 with every body >= 6.6x; fission strips show the ring pinching into a figure-8 and each daughter closing its own ring with cargo ~10x. Gate off (beta=0): 1.1x. Matched Laplacian-only controls: (1) for W, beta=0 with the cargo D lowered uniformly: Dc 0.02 keeps every body >= 2.7x (5.5x aggregate), Dc 0.1 ends at 2.0x; so W is met by slow diffusion alone. (2) For B, the adsorption drift removed so q only diffuses (chi_q=0) at Dq 0.5, 0.05 and 0.005: q peaks in the core (rim/core 0.94, 0.73, 0.49; 0-1/247 membrane-like), because q is made where amphiphile is densest; no uniform diffusivity makes a surface layer here.

verdicts.limitation: W is not beyond diffusion: a gate-free cargo with D lowered 50x keeps every body >= 2.7x. The shell layer is a quasi-equilibrium adsorption set by a chosen potential of u, 2-3 px wide at dx 0.5 (I did not re-run the 1.5x arm). Shell and cargo are passive, so division is that of fed FCH micelles and comes in synchronized waves; the neck leaks cargo at fission (daughters ~10x vs parents 20-50x). Generation 2 on this seed.
